svg.title: Held-out evaluation: answer quality, evidence recall, latency and tokens
svg.desc: 48 fixed questions from four conversations; evidence denominator 47. Evidence uses the last actually dispatched answer input. Initial and repair batches remain separate. Quality uses independent source review. Latency includes all attempts. Missing usage remains unknown. Monetary cost is not recorded.
